privacy.title: Ti’Magnet Privacy Policy

section1.title: 1. Data Controller
section1.content: The controller of personal data is:

section2.title: 2. Categories of Data Collected
section2.intro: We collect several categories of personal data.

list: Identifiers: name, first name, postal address;
Contact details: email address, phone number;
Customer account information;
Payment data (processed by a payment provider, not stored by us);
Correspondence via contact forms or customer service.

subsection2.title: 2.2 Automatically Collected Data
list: Navigation data (IP, pages viewed, visit duration);
Data from cookies and trackers (described in our cookie policy);
Technical data (device type, browser, operating system).

subsection3.title: 2.3 Photographic Data Transmitted by the User
subsection3.p1: As part of the customization of magnets, the user is required to import photographs that may contain personal data (images of people, children, private objects, etc.).
subsection3.p2: These files are processed exclusively for the purpose of fulfilling the print order and are not subject to any other processing.

subsection4.title: 2.4 Declaration of Rights and User Responsibility
subsection4.p1: The user guarantees to be the holder of all necessary rights (copyrights, image rights, exploitation rights) on the photographs they transmit, or to have the required authorizations from the persons concerned.
subsection4.p2: Ti’Magnet does not perform any prior verification regarding intellectual property, the identity of the persons represented, or the presence of trademarks, logos, or protected works.

subsection5.title: 2.5. Prohibition of Illegal or Immoral Content
subsection5.p1: It is strictly forbidden to transmit content of an illegal nature, including (non-exhaustive list):
list: child pornography, violent, hateful, or discriminatory content;
content contrary to public order or morality;
content infringing on the rights of third parties.
subsection5.p2: Ti’Magnet reserves the right to refuse any order or delete any manifestly illicit content, without compensation, and to cooperate with the competent authorities if necessary.

subsection6.title: 2.6. Non-Commercial Use of Photos
subsection6.p1: Unless expressly agreed in writing by the user, the transmitted photographs are never used for advertising, commercial, or promotional purposes.

section6.content: Data is only transferred outside the EU if appropriate guarantees are in place (standard contractual clauses or adequacy decision).

section1.content: A cookie is a small text file deposited on your terminal (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. Cookies allow your terminal to be recognized during your subsequent visits.
list: Strictly necessary for the functioning of the site (e.g., for the cart or security);
Functional (usage preferences);
Statistical / performance (navigation analysis);
Advertising or targeting (personalization of offers or display of advertisements).

subsection1.title: 2.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies
subsection1.content: These cookies are essential for the functioning of the site (e.g., cart, customer account connection). They do not require your consent but must be reported.
list: Session cookie
Cart cookie

subsection2.title: 2.2 Performance / Statistical Cookies
subsection2.content: These cookies allow us to measure the audience and optimize the performance of our site.
subsection2.note: These cookies are installed only with your prior express consent.

subsection3.title: 2.3 Personalization / Marketing Cookies
subsection3.content: These cookies may be used to personalize advertising or track your visits across different sites, in order to offer you adapted offers.
subsection3.note: These cookies are installed only after explicit consent.

section3.title: 3. Cookie Consent
section3.p1: During your first visit, a consent banner appears so that you can accept or refuse non-essential cookies.
section3.p2: We do not install any non-essential cookies before you have given your explicit consent.

sales.title: General Terms of Sales – Ti’Magnet

section1.title: Article 1 - Legal Information
section1.tva: VAT: VAT not applicable, article 293 B of the General Tax Code

section2.title: Article 2 - Object
section2.p1: These General Terms of Sales (GTS) govern the contractual relations between Ti’Magnet and any person (hereinafter "the Client") wishing to make a purchase via the website timagnet.com or by any other means of ordering proposed.
section2.p2: Ti’Magnet offers the creation and sale of custom magnets from photos provided by the Client.

subsection1.title: 3.1 Placing an Order
subsection1.intro: The Client places an order by:
list: Selecting the format and quantity of magnets desired
Uploading the photo(s) to be printed
Validating their cart and delivery information
Proceeding to payment
subsection1.p1: The order is definitively validated after receipt of full payment.

subsection2.title: 3.2 Order Confirmation
subsection2.intro: A confirmation email is sent to the Client summarizing:
list: The order number
The ordered products
The total amount including taxes
The delivery address
The estimated manufacturing and shipping time

subsection1.title: 4.1 Client Responsibility
list: To be the owner of the copyrights and image rights on all transmitted photos
To have the express authorization of any person recognizable in the photos
That the photos contain no illegal, defamatory, pornographic content or content contrary to morality
subsection1.p1: Ti’Magnet reserves the right to refuse any order whose content would be inappropriate or illegal.

subsection2.title: 4.2 Use of Photos by Ti’Magnet
subsection2.p1: The photos transmitted by the Client are used exclusively within the framework of manufacturing the ordered magnets.
subsection2.p2: In accordance with the GDPR and our commitment to protecting your privacy:
list: Photos are uploaded securely
They are used solely for printing your order
Photos are permanently deleted from our servers within a maximum of 30 days after order delivery
No photo is kept, shared, resold, or used for commercial or advertising purposes without your prior written agreement

subsection3.title: 4.3 Request for Authorization for Promotional Use
subsection3.content: Ti’Magnet may ask the Client for authorization to use photos of magnets made for promotional purposes (social networks, website). This authorization is optional and does not condition the acceptance of the order in any way.

subsection1.title: 5.1 Rates
subsection1.p1: Prices are indicated in euros (€), all taxes included (ATI). VAT not applicable according to article 293 B of the General Tax Code.
list: Magnet manufacturing
Protective packaging
subsection1.p3: Delivery costs are indicated separately and added to the order total.

subsection2.title: 5.2 Price Modification
subsection2.content: Ti’Magnet reserves the right to modify its rates at any time. Orders are invoiced based on the rates in effect at the time of order validation.

subsection1.title: 6.1 Payment Methods
list: By credit card (secure payment)
subsection1.p1: Payment is due immediately upon ordering.

subsection2.title: 6.2 Payment Security
subsection2.content: Online payments are secure. Ti’Magnet does not have access to and does not keep any banking data.

subsection1.title: 7.1 Deadlines
subsection1.intro: Manufacturing and shipping times are as follows:
list: Manufacturing: 1 to 3 business days after order validation and receipt of payment
Delivery: 2 to 4 business days (Mainland France)
Total estimated time: 3 to 7 business days
subsection1.p1: These times are given as an indication and may vary during periods of high activity (holidays, vacations).
subsection1.p2: In case of an exceptional order (more than 100 pieces), an additional delay may be requested.

subsection2.title: 7.2 Delivery Modes
list: Tracked Letter
Colissimo for large shipments
subsection2.p1: Corsica, DOM-TOM and international: Consult us for rates and deadlines.

subsection3.title: 7.3 Order Tracking
subsection3.p1: A tracking number is communicated to the Client by email as soon as the order is shipped.
subsection3.p2: The indicated delivery times correspond to average times communicated by carriers and are provided as an indication.
subsection3.p3: Ti’Magnet commits to shipping orders within the announced deadlines after manufacturing. From the moment the package is handed over to the carrier, delivery times are the sole responsibility of the latter.
subsection3.p4: Ti’Magnet cannot be held responsible for delays attributable to the carrier, particularly in case of strike, activity overload, exceptional weather conditions, or any other event beyond its control.
subsection3.p5: In case of abnormal delay or loss of the package, Ti’Magnet will assist the Client in steps with the carrier to find an appropriate solution.

subsection4.title: 7.4 Order Reception
subsection4.intro: The Client undertakes to verify the condition of the package in the presence of the deliverer. In case of a damaged package, the Client must:
list: Refuse the package or issue written reservations on the delivery note
Contact us within 48h enclosing photos of the damaged package (still unopened)

section8.title: Article 8 - Right of Withdrawal
section8.p1: In accordance with Article L221-28 of the Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal does not apply to personalized products made according to the Client's specifications.
section8.p2: Magnets being personalized products made to measure, they cannot be subject to a right of withdrawal.
section8.p3: Exception: In case of error on our part (printing error, manufacturing defect), an exchange or refund will be proposed (see Article 9).

subsection2.title: 9.2 Limits of Liability
